exposure: Region of residence (coastal vs. continental Croatia)
cohort: Pregnant women living in continental (Osijek) and coastal (Split) regions of Croatia
finding: Despite unfavorable maternal nutritional status and prolonged gestation, offspring of mothers from the coastal region had better nutritional status at delivery, while mothers from the continental region had a higher incidence of pregnancy disorders.
mod_finding: Maternal weight prior to delivery was associated with caesarean section in both regions.
